messages:
lina: Quick sync — post-launch backlog triage. We need a call on what we pull into the next sprint: critical bugs vs small UX enhancements vs a customer onboarding ask. Can we list wins/risks?

yusuf: I ran a quick perf pass last night. There's a regression on tokenization for long prompts (error rate +1.8%). That looks like a production bug, not an enhancement.

katie: Customer A is pushing hard for VPC onboarding (legal signed), but scope is bigger than a sprint. They want ETA.

sam: If tokenization regression is real we should prioritize a hotfix. SLOs degraded for a small subset of requests. Canary it.

raj: I reproduced the tokenization issue locally, seems tied to tokenizer v2 + batching edge case. I can test a patch but need a dev env with a longer prompt fixture.

lina: Proposal: 1) Ship tokenization hotfix (estimate 2-3 dev days + QA). 2) Defer prompt-template UX polish to backlog. 3) Start scoping VPC onboarding as a follow-on epic with a customer success checklist. Thoughts? :thinking:

yusuf: Agree with ordering. Hotfix -> canary 5% -> ramp. If patch is trivial we can do it in next sprint. I can own the PR.

katie: For VPC, recommend we create an MVP checklist and a sales-facing ETA: "Q2 private onboarding pilot" — keeps CS expectations realistic. Maya can confirm customer priority.

maya: Customer A is high priority but they accept a pilot timeline. They want a minor network docs set this month so they can start compliance review.

raj: QA plan for hotfix: add unit tests for tokenizer v2 + long prompt cases, end-to-end using fixture 'long_prompt_customerA.json'. I'll allocate 1 day once dev finishes.

sam: Ops runbook: canary using rollout tag `canary-token-fix`, monitor error_rate, latency p50/p95, and KV cache hit ratio. If errors drop to baseline -> ramp.

lina: OK concrete actions: Yusuf to open PR and label `postlaunch, hotfix`. Raj to write tests and run E2E. Katie + Maya will draft the VPC scope doc. Sam will prepare the canary job.

lina: Quick Jira labels snippet for triage:
```
project: INF
labels: postlaunch, hotfix, customerA
components: serving-runtime, tokenizer
```

yusuf: I'll aim to have a draft PR by end of day tomorrow. If it's larger than expected we do an emergency patch release and revert risky changes.

katie: I'll send the VPC checklist to the thread by EOD and loop legal.

raj: One concern — the tokenizer fix interacts with batching logic. If we cut a quick patch it must not change batching semantics. Will call out in review.

lina: Good call. Add a test matrix in the PR description covering batch sizes [1,8,32] and sequence lengths [128, 2048].

sam: Ops: canary plan details in #eng-oncall. I'll pin the dashboard and add alerts for >0.5% tokenization error increase.

yusuf: :thumbsup: assigning to me. Will tag Raj & Sam in the PR.

maya: I'll let Customer A know we plan a minor docs deliverable this month and a private onboarding pilot ETA.

deploy-bot: Release window available tonight 22:00 UTC if code is ready.

lina: Decision: hotfix goes in next sprint as top priority. UX polish/templating postponed. VPC onboarding scoped as separate epic with a pilot ETA. Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after PR review. :white_check_mark:
